0.long_answer: The question refers to the textbook published in 1953 by Robert Degos, the French dermatologist who first recognized Degos disease as a new clinical entity. Historical references indicate that Degos played a key role in producing a large French reference work, and his work appeared first in 1953 as part of the Jadassohn-Ergänzungswerk. This textbook is thus the one associated with his early recognition of the disease.
